fields.applicationSet: Configure the controller that generates Applications from templates.
fields.applicationSet.replicas: Set how many controller pods generate Applications. Zero stops the controller.
fields.notifications.enabled: Enable the notifications controller when application events should be sent to configured recipients.
fields.server.service.type: Use ClusterIP for access inside the cluster and port forwarding. Choose NodePort when the API and UI must be reachable on a node port.
fields.server.replicas: Choose the number of API and UI Pods to match availability and request capacity needs.
fields.repoServer.replicas: Choose how many repository servers share manifest-generation work.
fields.server.resources: Reserve capacity for API and UI requests and bound the server’s resource use.
fields.repoServer.resources: Reserve capacity for manifest generation and bound the repository server’s resource use.
fields.server.metrics.enabled: Create a metrics Service when a monitoring system needs to scrape the Argo CD API server.
fields.dex.enabled: Run Dex when the installation uses a connector for federated sign-in.
fields.server: Configure the Argo CD API server and web UI.
fields.server.service: Configure how Kubernetes exposes the Argo CD API and web UI.
fields.server.metrics: Configure metrics exposure for the Argo CD API server.
fields.repoServer: Configure the component that fetches repositories and generates manifests.
fields.dex: Configure the Dex identity service for federated login.
fields.server.resources.requests: Resources Kubernetes reserves when scheduling this container.
fields.server.resources.requests.cpu: CPU request for this container, expressed in cores or millicores.
fields.server.resources.requests.memory: Memory request for this container, expressed as a Kubernetes quantity.
fields.server.resources.limits: Upper bounds Kubernetes enforces for this container.
fields.server.resources.limits.cpu: CPU limit for this container, expressed in cores or millicores.
fields.server.resources.limits.memory: Memory limit for this container, expressed as a Kubernetes quantity.
fields.repoServer.resources.requests: Resources Kubernetes reserves when scheduling this container.
fields.repoServer.resources.requests.cpu: CPU request for this container, expressed in cores or millicores.
fields.repoServer.resources.requests.memory: Memory request for this container, expressed as a Kubernetes quantity.
fields.repoServer.resources.limits: Upper bounds Kubernetes enforces for this container.
fields.repoServer.resources.limits.cpu: CPU limit for this container, expressed in cores or millicores.
fields.repoServer.resources.limits.memory: Memory limit for this container, expressed as a Kubernetes quantity.
